label: Protein Structure Prediction
description: Predict biomolecular structures (proteins, complexes, protein-DNA/RNA, protein-ligand) using Boltz-2, OpenFold 3, Chai-1, AlphaFold 2, or ESMFold. Provides a unified interface with automatic parameter mapping, format conversion, output normalization, and confidence scoring. Advanced knobs (num_samples, num_recycles, seed, output_format, all tool-specific parameters) use sensible defaults from the predict-structure CLI; expose them via the PredictStructureFull spec or direct CLI / CWL invocation.

parameters.label: Prediction Tool
parameters.desc: Structure prediction engine. 'auto' picks the best available tool: Boltz > OpenFold > Chai > ESMFold > AlphaFold. Boltz-2, OpenFold 3, and Chai-1 are diffusion-based and support protein/DNA/RNA/ligand complexes (MSA fetched automatically via ColabFold server; optional msa_file upload overrides). ESMFold is fastest (single-sequence, protein-only, CPU-capable). AlphaFold 2 builds its own MSA from local databases (protein-only, hours).

parameters.label: Protein FASTA
parameters.desc: Protein sequence(s) in FASTA format (.fasta, .fa). Multi-chain complexes: include multiple sequences in one file. Maximum 26 sequences and 10,000 total residues per job. Boltz also accepts a YAML manifest for full feature support.

parameters.label: DNA FASTA
parameters.desc: DNA sequence(s) in FASTA format. Tools that support DNA: Boltz-2, OpenFold 3, Chai-1.

parameters.label: RNA FASTA
parameters.desc: RNA sequence(s) in FASTA format. Tools that support RNA: Boltz-2, OpenFold 3, Chai-1.

parameters.label: Ligands (CCD codes)
parameters.desc: Ligand CCD codes, 1-3 alphanumeric chars each (e.g. ATP, NAD). Glycans use their CCD codes here too (NAG, MAN, BMA, etc.) -- no separate glycan input. Tools with ligand support: Boltz-2, OpenFold 3, Chai-1.

parameters.label: SMILES Strings
parameters.desc: SMILES strings for arbitrary small molecules (use 'ligand' for CCD-coded compounds). Tools with SMILES support: Boltz-2, OpenFold 3, Chai-1.

parameters.label: MSA File
parameters.desc: Pre-computed Multiple Sequence Alignment (.a3m, .sto). Required for Boltz, OpenFold, and Chai (their dummy single-sequence fallback produces unusable predictions; external MSA servers are disabled by BV-BRC policy). ESMFold ignores MSA; AlphaFold builds its own from local databases. Auto-converted to tool-native format (Parquet for Chai, injected into YAML for Boltz, JSON for OpenFold).

parameters.label: Debug Mode
parameters.desc: Enable verbose debug logging. Sets P3_DEBUG=1 for the Perl service script and passes --verbose to the predict-structure CLI.

parameters.label: Output Folder
parameters.desc: Workspace folder for prediction results. Output includes the rank-1 PDB, an HTML report, results.json (CWL-style outputs map), and structured subdirs for inputs/, predictions/, reports/, metadata/, and raw/.

parameters.label: Output Name
parameters.desc: Job output name. Results land at ${output_path}/.${output_file}/ in the workspace.
